about: Lévis sits on the south shore of the St. Lawrence River, directly opposite Québec. It is a suburban and industrial city with ferry and bridge links to the capital, plus a long riverfront of cliffs and parks. The city amalgamated several former South Shore towns. About 150,000 people live in Lévis.
seoSummary: South-shore city facing Old Québec, with forts, a ferry, and cliffside terraces.
